g.text: Check the account type, the active subscription,
the placement and that the buyer is not the author
Lock the article row and read its full-purchase owner
SELECT the credit balance FOR UPDATE
Debit the magazine by 10% of the price
Credit the writer with the payout
Insert the purchase row, stage preview_unlock
Look up the prior preview for this article and magazine
Remaining = price minus what the preview already paid
Lock the article row and read its full-purchase owner
SELECT the credit balance FOR UPDATE
Debit the remaining amount, credit the writer
Insert the purchase row, stage full_purchase,
Article added to the library, owned and not yet published
Lock the article, check it is owned by this magazine
Make it public and free, clear the price,
Measured on a 100-credit article: 445 to 435 for the preview,
then 435 to 345 for the remainder. Ledger rows: 10 = 8 payout
+ 2 fee, then 90 = 72 payout + 18 fee. The row lock is what
stops two concurrent purchases spending the same credits.
